frame.name: 一枚銀の縁
frame.detail: Design 01: QUIET CHISELED SILVER. One continuous broad silver band with a single confident chamfer and a dark blue-gray recessed inner edge. Clean sculptural planar metal, elegant minimalist magical instrument. Tiny recessed eye symbol at twelve o'clock, cut into the band, not sitting outside it. Left is one unbroken ribbon of satin silver with NO decorative seams. Right uses exactly the same band and eye, with two short inset crimson enamel slits at 10 and 2 o'clock and a slightly stronger inset bevel, very restrained. Emphasize uninterrupted broad surfaces.
frame.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game UI FRAME SPRITE PAIR for LORE. Input 1 is current button/layout reference only; input 2 is the adopted HOME/Zeno style reference. Redesign ONLY the circular metal frame. Deliver TWO standalone annular frames side by side, LEFT common frame for both Single and Normal (same asset reused), RIGHT ranked frame based on the EXACT SAME structural skeleton with a modest prestigious accent. TRANSPARENT background AND completely TRANSPARENT EMPTY CENTRAL HOLES, no painted interior, no color disk, no scene, no captions, no text. Wide 2:1 sprite sheet. Two equally sized perfectly circular front-view rings, centered in the left and right square halves, no perspective. Same outer diameter, same hole diameter, same thickness for both. Outer diameter 88% of each square tile, central transparent hole diameter 76% of each tile; all details confined inside outer circle, no protruding crown/wings/ribbon. Style matches the attached HOME: crisp hand-painted cel shading, large clean light/mid/shadow planes, selective narrow highlights, refined Japanese fantasy game UI. Deliberate simple silhouette readable at 240px. No photorealistic scratches, noise, sparkle, generic ornate baroque floral carving, gothic spikes, gemstones, cog teeth, glossy 3D render. The center must be fully empty, alpha transparent, because the approved blue/navy/red fluid is rendered separately. Restrained silver/ivory metal; ranked may add small crimson enamel accents but no completely red frame. Design 01: QUIET CHISELED SILVER. One continuous broad silver band with a single confident chamfer and a dark blue-gray recessed inner edge. Clean sculptural planar metal, elegant minimalist magical instrument. Tiny recessed eye symbol at twelve o'clock, cut into the band, not sitting outside it. Left is one unbroken ribbon of satin silver with NO decorative seams. Right uses exactly the same band and eye, with two short inset crimson enamel slits at 10 and 2 o'clock and a slightly stronger inset bevel, very restrained. Emphasize uninterrupted broad surfaces.

pigment: Use case: style-transfer. Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an approved circular fantasy game button. Input 2 is STYLE CONTEXT ONLY: the current LORE HOME with Zeno, showing its refined hand-painted cel/toon world. Deliver ONLY the isolated button, no scene, no character, no text. User loves the existing button and asks for JUST A LITTLE more of that HOME/Zeno toon feeling, not a redesign. Preserve exactly the target's circular silhouette, all frame architecture and motifs, eye emblem, thickness, central empty face, size, positioning and transparent margin. Make a controlled material-style adjustment: reduce tiny noisy metallic scratches and photoreal granular sparkle, consolidate silver bevels into clear broad painted light/mid/shadow planes with a few precise bright edges, use clean dark painted contact edges (not thick black cartoon outline). Preserve substantial carved mass and premium dark-fantasy seriousness. Interior retains MULTIPLE existing shades and painterly pigment/cloud swirls, with larger more legible painted color shapes and softer fine grain; never turn it into flat fill or a smooth plastic gradient. Approximately 80% existing approved sophistication, 20% gentle cel-painted clarity. No new colors, no geometry redesign, no added ornament, no ribbons, no letters, no bevel exaggeration, no cute sticker/vector/mobile-game look. Front-on true circular object. Transparent alpha background preserved. This SINGLE variant keeps its gentle powder-blue, pale cyan, muted aquamarine, deeper teal-blue center, and thin silver frame. Softly welcoming, readable white text zone in center.
